name: Ghost Signals of the Orbital Relay
description: A derelict orbital relay has gone quiet, but several hosts still answer on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), inspect the services’ responses, and recover the relay’s archived record.

tasks.name: Recover the Relay Record
tasks.description: On the lab network, investigate the derelict relay hosts in 172.20.0.141-199. Identify the service that holds the station’s archived record and recover its contents.
hints: A port number is only a label. Compare how the open services respond when you connect.
One service speaks Finger. Consider how its query format differs from the usual web or mail dialogue.
An empty query can list available users. Inspect the profile for the archive account.
